Dossier racine Documents partagés d’un site SharePoint

parameters.fetchXml:
<fetch top="50">
  <entity name="systemuser">
    <attribute name="fullname" />
    <link-entity name="teammembership" from="systemuserid" to="systemuserid" link-type="any" intersect="true">
      <link-entity name="team" from="teamid" to="teamid" alias="teamGUID">
        <filter>
          <condition attribute="teamid" operator="eq" value="@{body('Récupérer_l''entité')?['_aglcm003_teamsa_value']}" />
        </filter>
      </link-entity>
    </link-entity>
  </entity>
</fetch>
